cabinCalling.text: CABIN CALLING — select CAB on the audio panel
cabinCalling.title: The real ACP CAB-CALL light is read-only in the SDK — this banner is the flash substitute

fo.title: Voice First Officer
fo.hint: Arbiter, TTS chain and playback status
fo.sterileTitle: Below the sterile ceiling in a workload phase, Low speech is dropped and Normal follows the configured policy
fo.listeningTitle: Engine truth: Listening means the recognizer is actually capturing; Paused is the pilot's ear-off latch (Stream Deck Voice Pause key / the button here)
fo.toggleTitle: Mute the FO's ear while you talk to a real person — the FO still speaks. Silent: no acknowledgement either way. Cleared by an app restart

tts.title: TTS Providers
tts.hint: Tried in order; a failed provider cools down 60 s. Test speaks with exactly that provider — no fallback

tests.title: Component Tests
tests.hint: Verify the LLM endpoint, microphone and nav database without flying a sector
tests.wakeTitle: Sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to every PC on Settings → Setup → Wake-on-LAN — then verify with Test LLM connection / Reconnect voice services
tests.reconnectTitle: Checks whisper and Kokoro now. Swaps recognition back to whisper if it answers and clears a Kokoro cooldown — the app also retries whisper every 30 s by itself
tests.failed: Test failed unexpectedly — see the Logs page.

minima.title: Arrival Minima
minima.hint: No DH/MDA dataref exists — enter the briefed minima to arm the minimums callouts
minima.untilSet: Until set, "one hundred above"/"minimums" stay disabled (logged once per flight).

speak.title: Speak Test
speak.hint: Runs the full arbiter → TTS → playback path at Normal priority
speak.placeholder: Something for the FO to say

unmatched.title: Heard but not understood
unmatched.hint: What you said this session that no command, checklist answer or question handler acted on — grouped, most repeated first
unmatched.trackingOff: Tracking is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → Recognition & Push-to-Talk → "Track phrases the FO did not understand".
unmatched.absorbed: {0} absorbed silently in sterile phases (callouts, not commands).
unmatched.heardTitle: Every miss this session, suppressed ones included
unmatched.repeatedTitle: A phrase heard three or more times is the one to add
unmatched.contextTitle: idle = no checklist open; checklist: … = that line was awaiting its answer; confirm-declined = the FO asked 'did you mean' and you said no
unmatched.teach: To teach the FO a phrase, add it where it belongs under {0}: a cockpit command in {1}, an ATC request in {2}, a checklist answer in the line's {3} under {4}. The FO reloads the files; the session log keeps every miss as {5}.

recent.title: Recent Utterances
recent.hint: Latest first — full history in the session event log
